convertibility_reason: The EA uses iCustom() calls for its core Fox Wave indicators (which are custom indicators, not built-in MT5 indicators). It also has complex multi-timeframe wave counting logic, hedge-style position management with opposite-side closures, and sophisticated money management that goes beyond simple fixed/percent sizing. The custom indicator dependency makes auto-conversion impossible without reimplementing those indicators.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots parameter is negative, use fixed lot abs(Lots); if positive, interpret as percentage of free margin for lot calculation. Dynamic lot sizing based on ATR and account free margin when Lots > 0.

custom_logic_notes: Elliott Wave-based EA using Fox Wave custom indicator for wave pattern identification. The core trading logic relies on iCustom() calls to the 'Fox Wave Clean_en' indicator which provides wave counts (A, B, C waves). The EA identifies completed wave patterns to enter trades in the direction of the next expected wave. It uses a combination of the custom wave indicator for directional bias and EMA crossover for timing confirmation. Position management includes closing opposite-side trades before entering new ones (quasi-hedge behavior). The digit adjustment (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5/3-digit brokers) is explicitly implemented.
python_conversion_notes: The Fox Wave custom indicator logic must be fully reimplemented in Python since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The wave-counting algorithm needs to be reverse-engineered from the .mq5 source of the custom indicator. The EMA crossover component is trivial (use talib.EMA). The digit adjustment logic for SL/TP is straightforward. The conditional position sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=margin-based) needs careful porting. The signal_reversal_close (close opposite before entering) is standard. Main risk: the custom indicator's internal wave-counting algorithm may use recursive or stateful logic across bars that is non-trivial to replicate outside MT5. Recommend obtaining the Fox Wave indicator source code or pre-computing wave signals via MT5 and exporting as CSV for backtesting.
